successRule: DELIVERED requires functional-equivalence PASS, before/after evidence at mobile/tablet/desktop, no unresolved critical blockers, independent QA, all critical UI dimensions >=90, and weighted UIX-100 score >=92.
exceptionalRule: UIX-100 score >=96 with all normal delivery conditions satisfied is PASS_EXCEPTIONAL.
revisionRule: Score 85.0-91.9 without critical failures is REVISE and must iterate rather than deliver.
failureRule: Score below 85, any critical dimension below 90, missing viewport evidence, failed functionality, unauthorized logic/scope change, self-approval, missing provenance, or unresolved critical blocker fails closed.
scopeBoundary: This team may improve presentation and user interaction inside the approved UI assignment. It may not silently redefine business rules, data ownership, permissions, billing, authentication policy, backend contracts, or product scope.
